name: barbell squat knees end position (form check)
description: A side-by-side form check for knee position at the bottom of a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and descend into a full squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees push out over your toes and do not cave inward.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.
